**+ речення** (підмет + дієслово): *alth:
**+ clause** (subject + verb): *although, even though, because, so, in case*
**+ noun / -ing:** *despite, in spite of, because of*
**New sentence + comma:** *However, … · Therefore, …*
**but / so** — in the middle, after a comma: *It was late, **so** we left.*

After *in case* — present tense: *in case it **rains***.
Despite + іменник, -ing або the fact tha: Despite + noun, -ing or the fact that + clause.
However з комою починає нове речення; al: However with a comma starts a new sentence; although and despite don't stand alone.
However, — на початку нового речення, з: However, — at the start of a new sentence, with a comma.
It was raining, ___ we stayed in. (1 сло: It was raining, ___ we stayed in. (1 word)
although / even though + речення; but —: although / even though + clause; but — in the middle.
because of + іменник (the holiday); beca: because of + noun (the holiday); because — before a clause.
despite / in spite of + іменник або -ing: despite / in spite of + noun or -ing.
despite — без of; of буває лише в in spi: despite — without of; of is only in in spite of.
in case — «на випадок, якщо» + Present S: in case — “to be ready if” + Present Simple.
in case — роблю зараз, бо щось може стат: in case — I do it now because something might happen.
so — “and that's why”, it introduces a result.
so — у розмові, therefore — в офіційному: so — in speech, therefore — in a formal text.
Беру в будь-якому разі, про всяк випадок: I take it anyway, just to be safe.
It was cold. However, we went out.
Візьми готівку — раптом там не приймають: Take some cash — they might not take cards there.
Візьми куртку на випадок, якщо похолодає: Take a jacket in case it gets cold.
I'll take an umbrella — it might rain.
Візьму перекус на випадок, якщо зголодні: I'll take a snack in case we get hungry in the Carpathians.
I'll take a taxi if it rains.
I'll take it only if it really rains.
Готель був чудовий. Проте їжа була жахли: The hotel was great. However, the food was awful.
Два окремі речення; however — на початку: Two separate sentences; however — at the start of the second.
Магазин був зачинений, тож ми пішли додо: The shop was closed, so we went home.
We were late as there was a lot of traffic.
The storm kept us at home.
Before a noun — despite / in spite of.
It rained, but the match still went ahead.
Попри затори, ми приїхали до Дніпра вчас: There was a lot of traffic, but we still got to Dnipro on time.
Після despite не буває підмета з дієслов: After despite there is never a subject with a verb — only a noun or -ing.
Після in case — теперішній час, а не wil: After in case — present tense, not will.
The storm led to the flight being cancelled.
Сполучники показують, як пов'язані думки: Linking words show how ideas are connected: contrast, reason, result or a safety step. Without them speech sounds like a list of separate phrases; with them it sounds like a connected story.
Українське «хоча…, але…» англійською — л: In English you use only one word, not “although…, but…”.
Хоча було пізно, ми лишилися ще на одну: It was late, but we still stayed for one more coffee.
It was cold, but we still went out.
Хоча готель у Чернівцях був дешевий, він: The hotel in Chernivtsi was cheap, but it was very clean.
I was tired, but I still went to my workout.
Я б із радістю прийшов. Однак того дня м: I'd love to come. However, I have to work that day.
